name: IC Analog Op-Amp — 3V — SOIC
description: A cluster of 3 tier A surface-mount 3V analog operational amplifier ICs in SOIC-8 and SOIC-14 package footprints.
selection_hints: Choose based on required footprint: SOIC-8 (3.9x4.9mm) or SOIC-14 (3.9x8.7mm) with 1.27mm pitch.
Select among surface-mount Tier A representative parts LT1492, MC33172, or MC33174.
Use when 3V analog operational amplifier ICs in SOIC packaging are specified.
avoid_when: A non-SOIC package footprint or through-hole mounting is required.
Footprint requirements differ from SOIC-8 3.9x4.9mm P1.27mm or SOIC-14 3.9x8.7mm P1.27mm.
The application requires operational amplifiers outside the 3V SOIC class.
